description: First step of starting an AI App Builder app from a document on this computer: a statement of work from a client, an idea doc or a spec (PDF, Word .docx, TXT or Markdown, up to 10 MB; scanned pages without text cannot be read). The file is uploaded, checked for known malware, and only its text is kept. Optional idea adds a line of your own; kind mobile (iOS and Android, default) or web. appId (optional) = the app id for the stores, only when the person has one. Answers doc (name, pages, characters, truncated = only the start of a long text is used), intake (the id for builder_answer_questions), summary (what we understood), name (the suggested app name), questions (0 to 3, only about what the document leaves open: id q1 to q3, text and chips numbered from 0), designCredits and creditsLeft. Free: no credits. Ask the questions one at a time, then an optional note, then call builder_answer_questions (it costs designCredits: ask first). Developer role. Every plan with an account.

appId.description: Optional app id for Google Play and the App Store (Android package and iOS bundle id), like com.yourcompany.app. Cannot change after the first store upload. Leave out for the generated one.

idea.description: A line of your own about the app (optional)

name: builder_start_from_document
title: Start a builder app from a document
